title: Second and third conditionals: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.explanationEs: Yo que tú: If I were you.

items.prompt: If we had left on time, we ___ the plane.

items.statement: If he had studied, he would have passed.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 3 correcto: had studied + would have passed.

items.statement: If I had known, I would told you.
items.explanationEs: Después de would, have + participio: I would have told you.

answers: Would you help me if I asked you?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta imaginaria: would + sujeto + verbo, y if + pasado simple (asked).

items.text: If it ___ (not / rain) yesterday, we ___ (to go) to the beach.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 3: hadn't + participio y would have + participio de go (gone).

items.source: They would live in the countryside.
answers: They wouldn't live in the countryside.
They’d not live in the countryside.

items.sentence: If she had called me, I would have answer.
items.explanationEs: Después de would have, el participio: answered.
